prompt: Create one photographic editorial still-life image for a software portfolio project called Go Fetch, a semantic search system for a personal PDF library. No words, no logos, no interface, no lettering, no fake laptop, no illustration, no Polaroid border. Landscape 4:3 composition suitable for a small printed photograph. Real-camera aesthetic, daylight from a nearby window, slightly imperfect lived-in material, medium-format film-like color with subtle natural grain. Subject: a small stack of thick off-white paper folders and loose documents on a worn dark green library desk. One narrow warm red index tab protrudes unmistakably from a single selected sheet, drawing the eye. A small metal binder clip beside it. Frame close enough that the folder textures and single red tab read at thumbnail size. A few very faint indistinct ruled marks are okay but no legible text anywhere. Quiet, intelligent, tangible, slightly playful, asymmetrically framed. Authentic shadows, soft side lighting, muted ivory and forest green, restrained coral-red tab. Do not overstyle into luxury catalog photography, do not add many props or glowing sci-fi motifs. This is conceptual cover art, not evidence of a physical product.
